mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically for four consecutive weeks from -27.3 to -4.1, indicating a steady recovery in retail and recreation mobility; this momentum will persist over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC increased from -27.3 to -4.1 over four weeks
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days (-13.5).

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM crosses above 0 for two consecutive weeks, it signals a shift to in-person shopping that spills over into retail and recreation, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from -9.0 to 11.3, crossing zero at t-2w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 0 for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in TRANSIT (from -38.4 to -13.1) and decline in RESIDENTIAL (from 4.7 to 1.4) indicates people are leaving home more for work and leisure, which increases retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose 25.3 points while RESIDENTIAL fell 3.3 points over four weeks
failure_condition: If the joint condition of rising TRANSIT and falling RESIDENTIAL holds but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where WORKPLACES mobility recovers (from -41.7 to -19.7), commuting patterns return, boosting weekday retail footfall and lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES increased from -41.7 to -19.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains above -25 but RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains exceptionally high (68.3% above baseline), indicating strong preference for outdoor activities that substitute for indoor retail, which will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS averaged 68.3 over the last week, far above baseline
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above 60 but RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: The divergence between GROCERY_PHARM (positive at 11.3) and RETAIL_REC (negative at -4.1) signals a shift from essentials to discretionary spending as consumers regain confidence, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is 11.3 while RETAIL_REC is -4.1, a 15.4 point gap
failure_condition: If the gap between GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC does not narrow over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT crosses above -15, it signals the relaxation of mobility restrictions, which will quickly translate into higher retail and recreation mobility over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose to -13.1 at t-0w, crossing above -15
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains above -15 but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: High PARKS mobility combined with low RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates favorable weather and increased outdoor leisure, which drives foot traffic to retail and recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is 68.3 and RESIDENTIAL is 1.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If the joint condition holds but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days.
